notes.title: [Announcement] 64-Bit Client Update and 32-Bit Discontinuation on September 25th
notes.notes:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

As previously announced, to provide players with a more stable gaming experience, we will discontinue support for 32-bit clients and transition to 64-bit clients starting with the upcoming September 25 maintenance.

The 64-bit client update will be applied across all platforms, including Steam.  Please check back in advance to ensure smooth gameplay.


■ How to check current operating system [Link]
 - If the PC already has a 64-bit Operating System, an upgrade is not needed to play.

■ How to upgrade to 64-bit Operating System
 - First, check the 64-bit support for the current CPU.
- [Windows 10]: Settings > System > About > System Type
- [Windows 8/8.1]: Settings > PC Info > System Type
- [Windows 7]: Start Menu > Right-click Computer > Properties > System Type

 - In System Type, if the CPU includes "64-bit processor" or "x64", the CPU supports 64-bit.
64-bit client can be used to play after updating to 64-bit Windows.
[64-Bit Windows Update Link]

 - In System Type, if the CPU includes "32-bit processor" or "x86", the CPU does not support 64-bit.
64-bit client can be used to play after changing the CPU for one that supports 64-bit Operating Systems and updating to 64-bit Windows.

※ Additional Details
- Players who are currently using the 32-bit client are asked to upgrade to the 64-bit client before the September 25th maintenance.


We will strive to create the best experience possible.
Thank you.

notes.title: [Announcement] Notice for 64-bit Client Update on July 3rd
notes.notes:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

As mentioned in the previous announcement, in order to provide a more stable gaming experience, 
we are planning on updating to the 64-bit client during maintenance on July 3rd.

There will be a period in which the 32-bit client can still be used after the update to the live servers.
However, please note that after the period is over, players must update to the 64-bit client.
We will announce the end of support of the 32-bit client in a separate announcement.

■ How to check current operating system [Link]
 - If the PC already has a 64-bit Operating System, an upgrade is not needed to play.

■ How to upgrade to 64-bit Operating System
 - First, check the 64-bit support for the current CPU.
- [Windows 10]: Settings > System > About > System Type
- [Windows 8/8.1]: Settings > PC Info > System Type
- [Windows 7]: Start Menu > Right-click Computer > Properties > System Type

 - In System Type, if the CPU includes "64-bit processor" or "x64", the CPU supports 64-bit.
64-bit client can be used to play after updating to 64-bit Windows.
[64-Bit Windows Update Link]

 - In System Type, if the CPU includes "32-bit processor" or "x86", the CPU does not support 64-bit.
64-bit client can be used to play after changing the CPU for one that supports 64-bit Operating Systems and updating to 64-bit Windows.

※ Additional Details
 - On July 3rd maintenance, the Steam Client will be updated to 64-bit/32-bit.
Other clients will stay at 32-bit and be updated to 64-bit over time.
 - Upon starting the client after the update to the servers, the client wil automatically update to the 64-bit client and be used as the default client.
 - In order to use the 32-bit client, a separate method must be used. Details will be included in a separate announcement at a later date.

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/f2cb1ef247fcc309e49842eb74e639cc85056f2d.png

Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

   We'd like to thank everyone who has provided us with their opinions through the survey and other methods.
Please do understand that we cannot reflect all the requests that players have given us.
We have prioritized the first balance changes to be brought on September 27th.
Please see the below improvements and provide us with your opinion about the oncoming changes. We will review your feedback in regards to the balance changes.

1. Adjusted the performance of skills that were affected by Monster size.
   We have adjusted certain characters that benefited too much from this mechanics, but we took extra care to not to reduce their damage by too much.
   For characters who don't have a skill set that benefits from this issue, we have raised the value of other skills to make up for the loss.
2. We will also reduce the skill cooldown for AP characters in dungeons to improve their usage in major dungeons since they cannot use skill charging.
3. Edel and Veigas will receive Job Stat skill added since they are considered lacking from not possessing any additional jobs.
   We will not just end with the addition of stats to both characters. We are reviewing changes with the assumption that skill and job change will be added in the future.
4. We are not only going to adjust the damage, but also the bug fixes and improvements to existing characters for better gameplay.

   We resonate with the players' request that balance needs consistent management and improvement. We will continue to monitor and improve the balance content for not just the ones adjusted on the first batch, but also those that were not included in the current balance adjustment.

notes.title: [Announcement] (Modified) Preview for Update in Development
notes.notes:
Hello, Heroes of Bermesiah!

We'd like to thank everyone for providing various feedback on the contents and system to improve GrandChase Classic.
The developers will check everyone's concerns and ideas and continue to strive to improve areas where lacking.
We'd like to share some of the improvement updates that could be considered important.

Currently, the developers of GrandChase Classic are reworking the Seal Breaker System, adding Coordi Fusion Disenchant and are working to improve the balance between characters.
Seal Breaker System Revamp and Coordi Fusion Disenchant system will be updated during maintenance on March 22nd
and improvements to character balance will take effect after we have gathered enough game data and players feedback via survey.
We look forward to your participation in the survey.

The first improvements we bring to the table is the Seal Breaker System Revamp.
The current Seal Breaker system uses a mix of drop rates and points and plan to adjust the system to solely depend on drop rates.
Since there are limitations to a system with drop rates as the only factor, we will be adding a drop gauge to insure a form of guaranteed drop.
We will also be improving other parts of the system for a better experience.


1) Coordi Item Acquisition Method will be changed
 - The point system will be removed so that Coordi items will be acquired based on drop rates.
 - Players will have varying drop rates in acquiring a Coordi item based on the number of Coordi items they have yet to acquire.
 - If the player successfully acquires a Coordi item, the player will get a random Coordi item that is not in current possession on equal rates.
 - The rates for Coordi items will be announced separately.

2) Gauge System will be added
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/702752218571fdeb2d8ab136652c36356515b5da.png
 - Every time the player fails to acquire the Coordi item via Seal Breaker, the gauge will increase.
 - If the gauge reaches full, players will receive an unacquired Seal Breaker Coordi item with equal rates.
 - The gauge will reset if the player acquires a Seal Breaker Coordi item.
 - There will be individual gauge that will accumulate and reset separately for each Seal Breaker Coordi.
 - The gauge will reset after the Seal Breaker Event ends.

3) List of Non-Coordi Items will be improved
 - Remove Large Potion Package 1 and Medium Potion Package 1 since the value of these packages go down as players reach higher levels.
 - Add Demons of Yore Potion Recovery Package, Demons of Yore Potion Special Package, Harrier Monster Card Box, Another World Monster Card Box, Grade 15 Reinforcement Scroll, Grade 13 Reinforcement Scroll, and Grade 11 Reinforcement Scroll.

4) Sealed Gems will be removed
 - Players can now use Seal Breaker Scrolls without Sealed Gems.

5) Consecutive Seal Breaker System will be added
 - A new function will be added that will allow players to attempt Seal Breaker consecutively.
 - Consecutive Seal Breaker will continue to unseal until the player acquires the Coordi Item, the player runs out of Seal Breaker Scrolls, or the player reaches max gauge.

The second improvements to follow is the Coordi Fusion Disenchant System where players can restore the appearance Coordi Item used in Coordi Fusion.


Coordi Transformation, Coordi Fusion, and Coordi Fusion Disenchant function will be integrated into 'Customize Coordi' tab.
1) Coordi Fusion Disenchant: Fusion Disenchant is a system where players can disassemble the Fused Coordi Item to restore the stat Coordi Item and the Appearance Coordi item.
 - How to Use: Go to Inventory > Press [Customize Coordi] > Press [Fusion Disenchant] > Register Fused Coordi Item to be Disenchanted > Disenchant
 - Players can consume GP to perform their first Fusion Disenchant.
 - Players will not be able to perform Fusion Disenchant if they have no inventory space.
 - The Fused Coordi Item will be separated into Appearance Coordi Item and Stat Coordi Item.

2) Fusion Disenchant
2-1) Appearance Coordi
 - Disenchanting a regular Coordi Item causes the items to be disenchanted back to their original rank and stats.
 - Disenchanting an equipment item causes it to be disenchanted into the Coordi Transformed Item following the rules below. (Players can check the stat changes if they transform the disenchanted Coordi item back as the equipment)
1. Cash Equipment: Restored as Epic rank and with selectable stats.
2. Certain GP Equipment (Fixed Rank): Restored as fixed rank and with random stats.
Ex) Legendary Rank Phantom Phoenix, True Iron Dragon, Event Dungeon Equipment, etc.
3. Other GP Equipment (Random Rank): Restored as Rare or Epic rank and with random stats.

2-2) Stat Coordi
 - After the Disenchant, Stat Coordi will be changed back to the original appearance.

3) Other Improvements
 - Added the following line to Coordi Transformation Tip: 'The rank and stats may change if you Fuse and Disenchant Coordi Transformed Equipment.'
 - Fused Coordi Item will be changed so that it will not be marked in the apperance and stat list once it is fused.
 - Added to following line to Coordi Fusion Tip: 'Fused Coordi Items cannot be used in Coordi Fusion.'

The third improvement will be the balance update.
We are reviewing all the community feedback and the game data to scrutinize which characters to opt for balance revamp.
In order to receive more feedback and to bring forth high quality improvements, we will conduct a survey to receive more opinion.


 - Survey Period: March 15, 2023 (Wed) 06:00 - March 22, 2023 (Wed) 23:59 (UTC+0)
 - Please participate in the survey found in the link and provide us feedback regarding character balance.
 - We will review each and every feedback and work towards balance revamp.
 - link: https://forms.gle/8aKhx7WxaSGmVwpAA

Thank you for supporting us even in times where we were lacking.
We will continue to strive for a better GrandChase Classic by reviewing various opinions of the players.

Thank you.

notes.title: 3rd Update Notice on August 3, 2022: 2nd Character Balance Adjustments
notes.notes:
Character 2nd Balance Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811643/b459986d642347bb6066bf05b6868bb4b3b340d8.png
 - Changed the character stat adjustment in PVP
 - Adjusted all character damage in PVP due to the changes in stat adjustment
 - Adjusted Practice Mode to allow testing with adjusted stats
 - Fixed skills to have separate stats in dungeons and in PVP and fixed skill tooltips to show PVP stat values separately from dungeon stat values (Tooltip has been added where missing)
 - Adjusted certain Rune set effects in PVP
 - Adjusted some of the normal attack type and special type applied in damage
 - Added Combo Down system to PVP


1) Adjusted Stats
 - Attack, Defense, Vitality, Special Attack, Special Defense, Critical Strike Chance, Critical Strike Damage, Critical Strike Damage Resistance, HP Recovery, MP Recovery 


2) Stat Adjustment Method

2 - 1) Adjustment Method 1
 - Attack, Defense, Vitality, Special Attack, and Special Defense will use the below method for adjustment.
 - Adjust stats based on the players' stats within the PVP room to calculate highest and lowest stats and adjust the stats as follows:
 - Highest stat in the stat comparison will be adjusted to the highest value below, and the lowest stat will be adjusted to the lowest value below.
 - Other stats will be adjusted to the value somewhere in the range below.
 - Attack: 3330 - 3700
 - Defense: 1440 - 1600
 - Vitality: 3807 - 4230
 - Special Attack: 5580 - 6200
 - Special Defense: 900 - 1000

2 - 2) Adjustment Method 2
 - Critical Strike Chance, Critical Strike Damage, and Critical Strike Damage Resistance will use the below method for adjustment.
 - Adjust stats based on a separate formula into the following range:
 - Critical Strike Chance: 0 - 15%
 - Critical Strike Damage Increase: 0 - 100%
 - Critical Strike Damage Resistance: 0 - 97.53%

2 - 3) Adjustment Method 3
 - HP Recovery and MP Recovery will use the below method for adjustment. MP Recovery has stayed the same as before.
 - HP Recovery: 50% Applied from Equipment Stats, and limited to 50% of Total Stat (Added a tooltip to the Stat Window)
 - MP Recovery: 25% Applied from Equipment Stats, and limited to 25% of Total Stat (Same as before)


3) Adjusted Practice Mode to allow testing with adjusted stats
 - Players can test stats adjusted to the below values:
 - Attack: 3700
 - Defense: 1600
 - Vitality: 4230
 - Special Attack: 6200
 - Special Defense: 1000


4) Improvements to Skill Tooltip
 - Added tooltips to skills with effects that have a different value whether it was used in Dungeons or in PVP
 - Emphasized the "Resurrection" with color in tooltips


5) Adjusted Rune Set Effects in PVP
 - Rune Set Effects that are adjusted in PVP will be shown separately in the tooltips.
 - Below effects apply to the adjustments in PVP.
 - Fury: Attack +1%
 - Endure: Defense +1%
 - Tolerance: Vitality +1%
 - Will: Max HP +2% on Resurrection
 - Focus: MP(AP) +3 on Resurrection
 - Fight: At Start of Combat, Ally Attack +0.5% (Max Stack 1%)
 - Guard: At Start of Combat, Ally Defense +0.5% (Max Stack 1%)
 - Enhance: At Start of Combat, Ally Vitality +0.5% (Max Stack 1%)
 - Limit: Attack +7.5% for 7 Seconds on Resurrection
 - Hunt: Damage +2% to Enemies Above 80% HP
 - Recovery: 5% Chance to Recover 15% of Max HP when Hit
 - Resurrect: Resurrect 1 Time in Fatal Status on a 50% chance
 - Rage: Attack +2% at Below 20% HP
 - Overcome: Defense +3% at Below 20% HP
 - Punish: Damage +2% to Enemies Below 30% HP
 - Protect: Reduce Damage by 3% from Enemies Above 80% HP

 - Changed the type of normal attack type skill damage to special attack type
 - Changed the type of special type normal attack and command attack to normal type
 - Added a new type with no MP recovery to normal attack of MP and Hybrid characters


7) Added Combo Down System
 - Added a system with all characters having a limit to 'down' gauge. Down gauge increases when hit by basic attacks.
 - When attacked, down gauge increases differently based on attack
 - When down gauge reaches the limit, combo down occurs.
 - When combo down occurs, an effect will occur and the character will be forced into a down state with 2 seconds of Arena Invincibility.
 - Down gauge increases: When character is hit by normal attacks.
 - Down gauge decreases: When character is hit by special attacks. Down gauge also decreases gradually when the character is not under attack.
 - Down gauge stays the same: When character is hit while under the effect of Super Armor or Hyper Armor
 - Down gauge reset: When chacracter resurrects, enters down state, counterattacks, or changes to FATAL state

- Added a system with all characters having a limit to 'down' gauge. Down gauge increases when hit by basic attacks.
- When down gauge reaches the limit, combo down occurs.
- When combo down occurs, an effect will occur and the character will be forced into a down state with 2 seconds of Arena Invincibility.
- Down gauge increases: When character is hit by normal attacks.
- Down gauge decreases: When character is hit by special attacks. Down gauge also decreases gradually when the character is not under attack.

- Down gauge reset: When chacracter resurrects, enters down state, counterattacks, or changes to FATAL state
